artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan adding desc to 40 verified desc-less vim.keymap.set calls across 11 active Lua modules, with a whole-tree confirmation sweep.

memory_candidates.content: Review-finding counts over multi-line Lua/Vimscript call sites (e.g. 'N vim.keymap.set calls lack desc') are routinely wrong when derived from a line-oriented grep: a grep cannot see an options key that sits several lines below the call opener, nor distinguish a generic helper body that threads desc from a parameter. A parenthesis-balanced scan (walk from the call opener, track depth, test the whole extracted call text for the key) is the cheap correct instrument, and should be run at plan-authoring time rather than trusting the figure carried from the review or research report. In task 295 this moved 44 -> 41 raw -> 40 genuine defects, corrected two per-file breakdowns in opposite directions, and removed one entire file from scope that was already compliant.
